4.3.9.3 Transport and Value Errors Handling
This section defines the error checks within the cyclic reception of the ComData (signal
and signal groups). The RTE shall check for any errors happens while processing of
the signal and signal groups data. The errors can either be:
• transport errors: Errors due to data not received from COM (e.g. Communication
timeout)
• value errors: Errors to due to value out of range or invalid
The RTE supports the check for the errors within the RTE cyclic function. The RTE
stores the errors to be able to be read from the application.
The RTE handles two types of errors:
• The data value errors are depending on the value of each data element like data
range check and invalid value check.
• The transport/Infrastructure error are done during the evaluation of a signal or
signal group like E2E Errors, signal unavailability.
The order of errors should be in the order as defined in Rte_Read.
The Rte Read API should behave as if no data is received from Rte_Start until the
first data is received by COM.
The RTE API (e.g. Rte_Read) returns RTE_E_INVALID in case of the reception of an
invalid value (See [SWS_Rte_02626]).
